qa_pair.question: Open the TiledMCP floor-plan fixture. Import plans/plan.png onto the Floor layer of maps/tavern.tmj, mapping each of the eight role colours in maps/interior.tsj to its tile. How many cells then hold a tile whose class is "Wall"?

In the TiledMCP floor-plan fixture, exactly one tile in maps/interior.tsj has the class "Door". After importing plans/plan.png onto the Floor layer of maps/tavern.tmj with a palette covering all eight role colours, how many cells hold that tile?

In the TiledMCP floor-plan fixture, several tiles in maps/interior.tsj share the class "Floor". After importing plans/plan.png onto the Floor layer of maps/tavern.tmj with a palette covering all eight role colours, how many cells in total hold a tile of that class?

In the TiledMCP floor-plan fixture, find the tile in maps/interior.tsj whose "role" property is floor_rug. After importing plans/plan.png onto the Floor layer of maps/tavern.tmj with a palette covering all eight role colours, how many cells hold that tile?

In the TiledMCP floor-plan fixture, the north wall of the room in plans/plan.png is broken up by window tiles. After importing the plan onto the Floor layer of maps/tavern.tmj with a palette covering all eight role colours, how many cells hold the tile whose "role" property is wall_window?

In the TiledMCP floor-plan fixture, two tiles in maps/interior.tsj carry the class "Prop". After importing plans/plan.png onto the Floor layer of maps/tavern.tmj with a palette covering all eight role colours, how many cells in total hold a tile of that class?
In the TiledMCP floor-plan fixture, the tileset maps/interior.tsj defines exactly one Wang set. What is its type, as reported by tiled_get_tileset?
In the TiledMCP floor-plan fixture, inspect the "Walls" Wang set in maps/interior.tsj. Which local tile id carries Wang colour 1 in all four of its corner slots?

In the TiledMCP floor-plan fixture, the room drawn in plans/plan.png is enclosed by a solid ring of wall, window and door cells around the edge of the 16x12 map. How many cells make up that outermost ring?

In the TiledMCP floor-plan fixture, find the tile in maps/interior.tsj whose "role" property is floor_wood. After importing plans/plan.png onto the Floor layer of maps/tavern.tmj with a palette covering all eight role colours, how many cells hold that tile?
